items.title: Bitmine posts $6.3B net loss for fiscal 2026 as Ether prices slide
items.body: Bitmine booked $6.2 billion in unrealized losses on digital assets. It held 6.07 million ETH on Sunday, or 4.97% of Ether’s supply.

items.title: Morning Minute: Vitalik Recasts ETH as a Store of Value
items.body: It’s a big shift for Ethereum from the “ultrasound money” days. But can ETH compete as a store-of-value play?

items.title: Ex-employee sues Ethereum Foundation and Vitalik Buterin over firing

items.title: An 11-year-old Ethereum wallet moved $4.6 million and dodged a scam set up in minutes
items.body: Bots spotted a wallet from Ethereum’s 2015 launch the moment it stirred and planted lookalike addresses in its history, but the owner sent the money to the right place anyway.

items.title: Vitalik Buterin Moves On From ‘Ultrasound Money,’ Says ETH’s Value Is Stability
items.body: The Ethereum co-founder says ETH's value comes from stability, not fee burns, citing its decentralization, censorship resistance and security.
